decisions.reason: As a design-led finish extension that remained visible and was even given its own page in 2024, it likely has low carrying costs and fits the firm's bathroom concept well, so the option is worth keeping open.
This product matches the firm's strategic push into seamless, modern and barrier-free bathroom architecture, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests enough traction to justify retaining it.

Because it is a newer and more technically specific pump-based offering, uncertainty is still higher and the firm has shown it will prune weak pump concepts, but after only one year it is still rational to keep the option alive while market feedback develops.
